name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LinearVerif.check_alternative
title: Linear verification over a field: M pi = v is solvable iff every key k with k^T M = 0 has k^T v = 0
statement: For a matrix M over a field K (rows r, columns c, finite) and a vector v, there is pi with M *v pi = v if and only if every k with k ^T M = 0 satisfies k . v = 0 (Fredholm alternative). This is the algebraic core of witness encryption from linearly verifiable proofs: the hash-proof ciphertext (k^T M, k . v + mu) is decryptable with an accepting pi exactly in the first case.
